# coding_tools

coding_tools is a local AI git commit message generator that turns diffs into conventional commits with Gemma and llama.cpp.

## Canonical pages

- Documentation site: https://mikaeltorni.github.io/coding_tools/
- Repository: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools
- README: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools/blob/master/README.md
- Entry point: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools/blob/master/main.py
- Source modules: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/coding_tools/tree/master/src
- Workflow diagram: https://mikaeltorni.github.io/coding_tools/commit-flow.svg

## Quickstart

```bash
conda create --name ct python=3.12.8 -y
conda activate ct
python3 main.py --help
```

Start a local llama.cpp server with the documented Gemma GGUF model before
running the tool against a repository path.

## Scope

This is an offline developer utility that suggests commit messages; it is not a
hosted commit API.
